; ghostbuster-eraser.qmd
; Automatically clear ghosting when erasing with the stylus

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var ghostBuster: root.parent?.ghostBuster ?? null

            Timer {
                id: eraserGhostBusterTimer
                interval: 400
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    let gb = (typeof root.ghostBuster !== "undefined" && root.ghostBuster) ? root.ghostBuster : root.parent?.ghostBuster;
                    if (gb) {
                        gb.forceClearNow("Eraser");
                    } else {
                        EPFramebuffer.scheduleGhostRemoval();
                    }
                    root.viewport?.requestRepaintDirty();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > ScenePenInputHandler#strokeHandler
        REBUILD onStrokeCompleted
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \controller.eraseWithLine(stroke);\ INSERT STREAM \ eraserGhostBusterTimer.restart();\
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
